# Third-party source provenance

The coherent-wave evidence archives the executed Python sources of mpmath1.3.0
for reproducibility. Its unchanged [license](mpmath-1.3.0-LICENSE.txt) is retained
here from the installed distribution. SHA-256: `c26cae81da4508e5e249985777a33821f183223ebb74d7f8cfbf90fe7eef2fb7`.
The source and license are not Universe24 engine code. The pinned research
requirement installs the original package normally; archived sources are evidence.
